semantics.city_rate_per_1000: 在县税 $1.10 之外另外加收的城市税基础税率。0 表示买卖双方不再多付：这些城市的 $0.55 已包含在县税 $1.10 之内（见 city_share_of_county_per_1000，只作说明，不要相加）。null 表示未能从官方来源查实。
semantics.tiers: 分档按成交总价落点决定，税率适用于全部成交价，不是超额累进。min 不含、max 含，max 为 null 表示无上限。rate_per_1000 是该档的法定税率；total_city_rate_per_1000 是该档应叠加在县税上的城市税合计，计算器请用这个字段。basis 为 in_addition_to_city_rate 时该税率加在基础城市税上，为 replaces_city_rate 时取代基础城市税。
semantics.total: 应付转让税 = 成交价/1000 ×（county_rate_per_1000 + 城市税率）。县和市都按 $500 为单位进位，且县税基数不含买方承接并留在房产上的贷款，所以实际金额以 Title/Escrow 结算单为准。

palo-alto.note_zh: Palo Alto 市法典 2.34.020：每 $500 收 $1.65，即每 $1,000 收 $3.30，加在县税之上。合计 $4.40。Santa Clara County 习惯上县税由卖方付、城市税买卖各半（Title 公司资料），可协商。县 Clerk-Recorder 税表本次未能打开，已用市法典核实。
palo-alto.note_en: Palo Alto Municipal Code 2.34.020: $1.65 per $500 ($3.30 per $1,000), on top of the county tax, for a combined $4.40. A title-company guide says the county tax is customarily paid by the seller and the city tax is split; this is negotiable. The county Clerk-Recorder table could not be opened, so the rate was verified from the city code.

cupertino.note_zh: Cupertino 的 $0.55（市法典 Chapter 3.04）是县税 $1.10 里分给城市的部分，卖方不再多付，合计 $1.10。官方来源是 2018 年发布在市政府网站上的财政分析；2025 年 12 月的 California City Finance 汇总表数字相同。市法典原文本次未能打开，建议成交前向 Title 公司确认。
cupertino.note_en: Cupertino's $0.55 (Municipal Code Chapter 3.04) is the city's share of the $1.10 county tax, so nothing extra is due; the total is $1.10. The official source is a 2018 fiscal analysis posted on the city website, and a December 2025 California City Finance table shows the same figure. The code text itself could not be opened; confirm with the title company before closing.

sunnyvale.note_zh: Sunnyvale 市议会 2024 年报告：总税率 $1.10，其中城市实际得 $0.55，没有另加的城市税。市议会在 2022、2024 年讨论过 $4 百万以上加税的方案，但本次未查到通过记录；2025 年 12 月的 California City Finance 汇总表仍为 $0.55。
sunnyvale.note_en: A 2024 Sunnyvale council report states the total rate is $1.10, of which the city effectively receives $0.55; there is no additional city tax. The council studied a higher tax on transfers of $4 million or more in 2022 and 2024, but no adoption was found, and a December 2025 California City Finance table still shows $0.55.

mountain-view.note_zh: $600 万及以下每 $1,000 收 $3.30（每 $500 收 $1.65）。Measure G 于 2024 年 11 月通过：总价超过 $600 万时每 $1,000 收 $15。注意：市政府转让税页面仍只写 $1.65/$500，没有反映 Measure G。市检察官分析写的是“总成交额超过 $6,000,000 时”，按此理解为全价适用，但未见明确写“全价”的官方文字，生效日也未查到；$600 万以上的成交请向 Title 公司确认。
mountain-view.note_en: $3.30 per $1,000 ($1.65 per $500) up to $6 million. Measure G, passed in November 2024, sets $15 per $1,000 when total consideration exceeds $6 million. The city's transfer-tax page still shows only $1.65 per $500. The City Attorney's analysis says the rate applies "when the total value of the consideration exceeds $6,000,000"; this file reads that as applying to the full price, but no official text found says so expressly, and no effective date was found. For sales above $6 million, confirm with the title company.

san-jose.note_zh: 基础 Conveyance Tax 每 $500 收 $1.65（每 $1,000 收 $3.30）。另加 Measure E（市法典 4.59，2020 年 7 月 1 日生效）：2025 年 7 月 1 日起 $230 万及以下免征；超过 $230 万至 $500 万 0.75%；超过 $500 万至 $1,000 万 1%；超过 $1,000 万 1.5%。税率按全部成交价计算，不是只算超出部分。起征点每 5 年按物价指数调整，市议会也可上调；$500 万、$1,000 万两条线未见调整。Measure E 规定双方均可支付，由谁付可协商。
san-jose.note_en: Base Conveyance Tax: $1.65 per $500 ($3.30 per $1,000). Measure E (Municipal Code 4.59, effective July 1, 2020) is added on top: since July 1, 2025, transfers of $2.3 million or less are exempt; over $2.3M to $5M, 0.75%; over $5M to $10M, 1%; over $10M, 1.5%. The rate applies to the full consideration, not just the amount above the line. The exemption threshold adjusts every five years by a consumer price index and the Council may raise it; the $5M and $10M lines show no adjustment. Either party may pay Measure E, so who pays is negotiable.

fremont.note_zh: Fremont 市法典 3.10.410：每 $500 收 $0.275（每 $1,000 收 $0.55）。依州法 R&T Code 11931，这笔税抵扣县税，不另外加收，合计 $1.10。Alameda County 的城市转让税表也没有列 Fremont。
fremont.note_en: Fremont Municipal Code 3.10.410: $0.275 per $500 ($0.55 per $1,000). Under R&T Code 11931 this is credited against the county tax rather than added to it, for a total of $1.10. Fremont is also absent from Alameda County's list of city transfer taxes.

milpitas.note_zh: 未能从县或市官方来源查实，请向 Title 公司确认。Milpitas 2025-26 预算只写了转让税收入约 $70 万，没有写税率；市法典和县税表本次都未能打开。非官方的 California City Finance 汇总表（2025 年 12 月）列为城市 $0.55、县 $0.55、合计 $1.10，仅供参考。
milpitas.note_en: Could not be verified from a county or city source; please confirm with the title company. The Milpitas 2025-26 budget shows about $0.7 million in transfer tax revenue but no rate, and the municipal code and county table could not be opened. The unofficial California City Finance table (December 2025) lists city $0.55 and county $0.55, $1.10 in total, for reference only.

dublin.note_zh: Dublin 市法典 3.08.020：每 $500 收 27.5 美分（每 $1,000 收 $0.55）。依州法 R&T Code 11931，这笔税抵扣县税，不另外加收，合计 $1.10。Alameda County 的城市转让税表也没有列 Dublin。
dublin.note_en: Dublin Municipal Code 3.08.020: 27.5 cents per $500 ($0.55 per $1,000). Under R&T Code 11931 this is credited against the county tax rather than added to it, for a total of $1.10. Dublin is also absent from Alameda County's list of city transfer taxes.

pleasanton.note_zh: Alameda County 的城市转让税表没有列 Pleasanton，即没有另加的城市税，合计 $1.10。$0.55 的城市分成来自非官方的 California City Finance 汇总表（2025 年 12 月），Pleasanton 市法典本次未能打开。2025 年 7 月有报道称市议会 3:2 停止了加税计划。
pleasanton.note_en: Pleasanton is not on Alameda County's list of city transfer taxes, so no additional city tax applies; the total is $1.10. The $0.55 city share comes from the unofficial California City Finance table (December 2025); the Pleasanton code could not be opened. July 2025 news coverage reported the council voted 3-2 to halt a proposed increase.

san-ramon.note_zh: Contra Costa County Recorder 只列 Richmond 和 El Cerrito 有在县税之外加收的城市税，没有 San Ramon，合计 $1.10。$0.55 的城市分成来自非官方的 California City Finance 汇总表（2025 年 12 月），San Ramon 市法典本次未能打开。
san-ramon.note_en: The Contra Costa County Recorder lists only Richmond and El Cerrito as collecting a city tax on top of the county tax, so San Ramon's total is $1.10. The $0.55 city share comes from the unofficial California City Finance table (December 2025); the San Ramon code could not be opened.

other.note_zh: 其他城市未核实，请向 Title 公司确认。部分城市的转让税远高于县税（例如 Alameda County 的 Oakland、Berkeley），不能按 $1.10 估算。
other.note_en: Other cities have not been verified; please confirm with the title company. Some cities charge far more than the county rate (Oakland and Berkeley in Alameda County, for example), so do not assume $1.10.
